messages:
Mira: starting a short triage on raven-liteq int4 streaming fragcases. we saw a parse success gap vs int8, want to decide mitigations (server vs client).
Arjun: what's the repro matrix? temps / batch / stream?
Mira: int4/int8, temps 0.0/0.3, stream vs non-stream, batch 1/4, 1k real prompts + 250 long-arg stress prompts.
Javi: running schema-coverage v0.3.2. collecting parse_failure_class, chunk-boundary hashes, and suffix-repair candidates.
bench-bot: job 1809554321-A kicked off on canary-gpu
Mira: baseline numbers: int8 stream parse_success 97.6%, int4 stream 80.2%. int4 non-stream ~89.1%.
Tess: that's large. looks streaming-specific — examples?
Mira: typical: model emits a long JSON string and the stream chunk cuts inside the string so client sees invalid JSON. sample:
```
{ "tool_call": { "name": "create_note", "args": "{\"body\": \"Full error dump:\nException at line 42: ...\"}" } }
```
Arjun: two broad fixes: (A) server-side chunk-coalesce heuristics (hold flush if last token looks like mid-string or unclosed bracket), (B) introduce lightweight framing header that clients can parse (e.g., prepend length or sentinel).
Javi: ran quick coalesce heuristic (32b lookahead): int4 stream success -> 90.9%, p95 latency +120ms. cheap but not perfect.
Mira: tried suffix-repair at finalization: small increase to 91.6% with +20ms, but repair can change semantics if we auto-close arrays/quotes incorrectly.
Tess: product ask: any observable bump in 5xx or OOMs?
Mira: minor memory pressure in conservative coalesce while buffering many concurrent streams; we increased per-worker buffer and retested. no persistent 5xx spikes after fix.
Lin: client-side framing is attractive: avoids server buffering and keeps latency low. but requires SDK changes and slow rollout.
Arjun: propose default: opt-in server coalesce for "enterprise/dedicated" customers + Console knob "parse-safety": low/medium/high that toggles coalesce depth and suffix-repair. meanwhile ship framing spec in SDK v0.9 and recommend for mobile/web clients.
Javi: also saw small class of int4 non-stream outputs with trailing commas and extra backslashes (~0.25%); filed RW-9001 for model-output cleanup and queued kernel-pad calibration to reduce token jitter.
Mira: action items: 1) enable coalesce opt-in flag behind feature flag and gate to tiers; 2) document framing header in SDK and start rollout plan; 3) run nightly canary sweep for p50/p95 latency + parse_success with coalesce on/off; 4) research RW-9001 and run int4 kernel pad experiment.
bench-bot: job 1809554660 finished; artifacts -> s3://redwood-canary/1809554321/artifacts (coverage-report + chunk-fingerprints).
Tess: thanks folks. we'll review artifacts in tomorrow's eng-ml sync and decide rollout. :mag:
